name: Ego-R1-Bench
description:
🧠 Ego-R1 Benchmark
	

We establish Ego-R1 Benchmark for ultra-long egocentric video understanding. 
It was proposed in the paper Ego-R1: Chain-of-Tool-Thought for Ultra-Long Egocentric Video Reasoning.

	
		
		📁 Dataset Structure
	

The Ego-R1 Benchmark contains 300 carefully curated question-answer pairs in total:

🏷️ 150 Human-Labeled: Manually crafted questions by 6 annotators, with 25 QA pairs from each perspective. 
🤖 150 Gemini-Generated + Human-Verfied: AI-generated… See the full description on the dataset page: https://huggingface.co/datasets/Ego-R1/Ego-R1-Bench.
reputation: Small, newly introduced benchmark for ultra-long egocentric video reasoning hosted on Hugging Face with limited adoption so far.
